description: The curated DeepFakeDetection (DFD) evaluation set: 363 actor reals and 3,068 fakes. Crops are a single curated track of the manipulated target, so mean-pooling over our crops is the per-identity aggregation; target_id is given so that grouping can be reproduced.
derived_from: the curated DFD face-crop tree (per-video meta.json)
